svg.title: Diffusion-driven instability of the Gray-Scott uniform state
svg.desc: Growth rate against wavenumber for four diffusivity ratios, and Turing's determinant condition.
svg.text: Turing instability at F = 0.0647, k = 0.0624 (stable without diffusion)
growth rate Re lambda per step
Du/Dv = 1 never goes unstable: the inhibitor must outrun the activator (here the substrate u, the faster species).
